C715471.failed_steps: Retest: the Failed result of 16 Nov is withdrawn; this test will be re-run with the same time-zone setting before and after.
observed: The Failed result of 16 Nov 2026 (ticket SV-12853) is withdrawn. Product closed SV-12853 on 17 Nov as expected behaviour: production shows the same Date, Due Date and Past Due when signed in at the same location.

The cause was our comparison, not the release: the screens captured before the release showed dates in UTC (the app's time-zone setting was not set), while the screens after the release were set to the location's time zone.
SV-12663 (Past Due counted from a different day than the Due Date shown) is fixed, as reported on 16 Nov.
